toneRules: Use plain language. Avoid jargon and acronyms unless defined on first use.
Write in active voice. Keep sentences under 25 words where possible.
Address the reader directly with second person ('you').
Avoid hyperbolic or marketing language in policy documents.
inclusivityRules: Avoid idioms that don't translate well across cultures.
Don't make assumptions about reader's job, location, or background.
accessibilityRules: Use descriptive link text. Never 'click here' or 'read more'.
Break long content into scannable sections with H2/H3 headings.
Use bulleted lists for steps or items. Number ordered procedures.
Provide alt text guidance for any referenced images.
formattingRules: Title must be present, descriptive, and under 80 characters.
Include a one-paragraph executive summary at the top.
Include 'Who this applies to' section identifying the audience.
Use Markdown headings (H2 for major sections, H3 for sub-sections).
